featured_reviews.name: Romil Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to express my serious dissatisfaction with the extremely unprofessional service I experienced today. I contacted your Virar East branch and placed an order for cake delivery to my address. Your staff accepted the order, confirmed it, and kept me waiting for nearly three hours, only to later message that delivery is not possible. This shows a complete lack of responsibility and coordination.

What made the situation worse was the rude and disrespectful behavior from your staff. This is absolutely unacceptable from any business, especially one dealing with customers’ important occasions.

Your service today has caused me inconvenience, wasted my time, and reflects very poorly on your shop’s reliability. I expect you to take strict action, train your staff properly, and ensure that such unprofessional behavior does not happen again.

featured_reviews.name: Reshma Shirke
featured_reviews.review_text: Order handled by Vignesh was not delivered as promised—important details like topper and name were missing. Delay in correction and poor quality replacement. On a repeat visit, his behavior was rude and unprofessional. Needs serious improvement in both service and communication.

featured_reviews.name: Dhanashree Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely pathetic experience at Jeden Cake Shop, Virar West. We clearly asked for the bigger-sized Dutch Truffle pastries, yet they packed the smallest, thinnest pastries possible as if customers wouldn’t notice the difference. Felt completely dishonest and cheap.

And to make things worse, whenever we called the shop regarding the order, the staff spoke very rudely and unprofessionally on the phone. If bigger pastries weren’t available, the basic courtesy would’ve been to inform the customer instead of silently downgrading the order and then behaving arrogantly when questioned.
Customer service here is genuinely disappointing. Won’t be ordering again. Please double-check your order before leaving because apparently customer instructions and respectful communication don’t matter here.

featured_reviews.name: Seon Almeida
featured_reviews.review_text:
Once More Bakery Cafe in Vasai is a delightful find! 😊 Tucked away, this charming cafe offers a warm and inviting ambiance that's perfect for a quick coffee break or a leisurely catch-up with friends. The moment you step in, you're greeted with the aroma of freshly baked goods and a cozy atmosphere that's simply beautiful.

We stopped by for a quick coffee and were impressed by the quality of their beverages. The cappuccino coffee was rich and expertly brewed, making it a great pick-me-up. We also tried their cheese cake pastry, which was moist, flavorful, and had just the right amount of sweetness.

The staff at Once More Bakery Cafe are friendly, attentive, and polite, making the overall experience even more enjoyable. They're happy to guide you through their menu and make recommendations.

With its delicious food, beautiful ambiance, and excellent service, Once More Bakery Cafe is a must-visit destination in Vasai. Whether you're a foodie, a coffee lover, or just looking for a cozy spot to relax, this cafe ticks all the boxes. Do drop by and treat yourself to a delightful experience! 👍
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your lovely review and for visiting Once More Bakery Cafe! We’re so happy to know you enjoyed the cappuccino, cheesecake, and the cozy vibe of our café. Your kind words about our team truly mean a lot to us and motivate us every day. We hope to serve you again soon do visit us again for more coffee and sweet treats!

featured_reviews.name: Khaunpeeyunmast
featured_reviews.review_text:
Once More Bakery Cafe in Vasai and Virar offers a delightful culinary experience that seamlessly blends comfort with sophistication. From the moment you step inside, you're enveloped in a cool ambiance that exudes soft vibes, creating a cozy atmosphere perfect for unwinding or catching up with friends.

The cafe's attention to detail extends to their impeccable service, where friendly staff members ensure a memorable dining experience. As you peruse the menu, you'll find a tantalizing array of options to satisfy every craving.

First and foremost, the food at Once More Bakery Cafe is nothing short of exceptional. Their croissants are a standout, boasting a perfect flakiness and buttery goodness that makes each bite a delight. Pair it with a freshly brewed cup of coffee, and you have a match made in heaven.

But the culinary delights don't stop there. Once More Bakery Cafe also offers Korean buns that are simply irresistible. With a delicate balance of flavors and a fluffy texture, these buns are a must-try for any food enthusiast.

For those with a sweet tooth, the dessert section is a paradise. Indulge in decadent treats that will satisfy even the most discerning palate. From cakes to pastries, each dessert is crafted with precision and passion, ensuring a truly indulgent experience.

In summary, Once More Bakery Cafe is more than just a cafe; it's a culinary haven where food lovers can come together to enjoy delicious fare in a charming atmosphere. Whether you're craving a comforting croissant, a flavorful Korean bun, or a sumptuous dessert, this cafe has something for everyone.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

featured_reviews.name: Soniii
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited Iyengar Bakery and the first thing that caught my attention was the beautiful interior and the overall bakery setup. The place looks very neat, clean, and well maintained. Hygiene and presentation are really impressive, and everything is arranged properly which gives a premium bakery feel. The atmosphere is pleasant and fresh, making the whole experience nice from the moment you enter.

They have a huge variety of bakery items and it’s honestly difficult to decide what to try. From cakes, pastries, cookies, puffs, mava cake, rava cake to many other snacks and desserts, there are so many options available. The display section itself looks very attractive and tempting.

Talking about taste, if I compare it with other bakeries, the rava cake was the item that I genuinely loved the most. It tasted fresh, soft, and really flavorful. Other items were okay for me personally, but the overall presentation, cleanliness, variety, and atmosphere made the experience good. A great bakery to explore different options and enjoy a proper classic bakery vibe.
